19.synopsis: The MC was a former WCG Shanghai champion and ranked 8th in the world. For some unknown reason he didn’t take part and disappeared. At some time later he was working at a brothel during the launch of a new almost realistic VRMMORPG . So the employer decided to close the brothel and with her group (including the MC) playing the game for fortune.

531.synopsis:
Freak Xie Ao Yu originally had no way of cultivating battle qi but, by accident, he got a mysterious godly pellet and he received a supreme emperor blade. That changed his destiny and from then on, he felt the real meaning of life and he made original time and space related battle skills and decisively battled ancient, huge clans and hundreds of continental clans in the Qi Ao continent.
Clouds formed with a flip of a hand and rain formed with another flip. He left the strongest mark in tens of thousands of years of history and created glorious chapters about a tyrant’s anger, blood shed for thousands of miles, the skies hissing from mad blades, and the allegiance acknowledgement of all times.

1299.synopsis:
He’s just a low-ranking deputy general and he’s a prince. They meet on the battlefield but it turns out to be the beginning of a complicated and beautiful story.
Murong Yu is a very confident man – until he meets Han Xin.
There’s nothing he cannot get; there’s nothing he cannot destroy.
To let live or not, is all up to him.
He is the future ruler of Great Yan and so it’s only natural that the world should bow down at his feet.
But he had never thought that one day he would lose control of it.
That even his own will would be uncontrollable.
Murong Yu can neither get nor destroy this prisoner of war.
Han Xin has never given a care about the world – until he meets Murong Yu.
He has never cared about anyone, nor has anyone cared about him.
It doesn’t matter if you’re alone or sad, as long as you can still laugh, life will go on.
He has learned long ago how to not question, how not to believe, how not to lose and how not to care.
Destiny’s uncaring teasing and humiliations have already become numb to him.
That’s right, he doesn’t have a care in the world.
Even if it’s this Prince Royal of Great Yan who’s started to warm up to him.

3347.synopsis: Konoe Yuuto is a genius martial artist who is summoned to a different world where s*ave trading is legal. There, using his 【Ability Looting ( Skill Taker)】 cheat ability, he steals the abilities of monsters he defeats, and starts building a s*ave harem while hoping to live a carefree life after retirement.
associated_names: Isekai Shihai no Skill Taker ~Zero kara Hajimeru Dorei Harem~
異世界支配のスキルテイカー　～　ゼロから始める奴隷ハーレム　～

3603.synopsis:
Young Chen Xiang had a fateful encounter with a goddess & demoness and received their peerless heritage, divine pulses, ultimate martial arts, and transcendent alchemy techniques, which gave him an easy ride in his journey of cultivation.
When hungry, he refines some spirit pills to eat as snack, when lonely he flirts with the goddesses, when bored he teases those martial artists who came to beg for spirit pills, when tired he lets his beautiful wives massage him.

4883.synopsis:
65 million years ago, Earth was ruled by all sorts of dinosaurs—from big to small.
In the Quaternary Period of the Cenozoic Era, humans became the Earth’s rulers.
Unfortunately, a great deal of humans from their birth to death can only make use of 3-5% of their brain. This is an incredible waste. The human brain has unlimited potential to be unearthed. As the depth of brain region increases, mankind can become smarter, become stronger.
Slowly, mankind began to re-examine themselves, re-examine the brain, and come up with all the ways to unearth their potential…
But, this all came too late. 2100 BCE, the 6th global extinction arrived.
   ……
“Lin Feng, 17 years old. Depth of brain region: 5.00%, 10th rank.” The examiner’s icy voice resounded.
Warring Era, 101st year. A brand new, future world. An era of science and technology that reexamines the human body’s potential. Lin Feng, who was on the brink of becoming a genetic warrior, experienced an extremely weird “brain region degeneration”. His brain region depth fell from 9.95% back to the starting point.
……
Lin Feng used to be a genius, towering above everyone else. However, due to an unfortunate accident, he fell to the very bottom. Yet, he was undeterred and continued to work hard so that one day he could reach his brother, and fulfill the oath they made together.

5651.synopsis:
In a world of dungeons and monsters you can become strong if you merely have enough money.
Rare skillbooks that can magically upgrade your skills in an instant are sold at exorbitant prices. So only the privileged and rich are able to buy their way to become hunters – a much revered occupation that allows one to enter dungeons and hunt monsters.
Our MC is a porter, a sort of caddie for hunters. He dreams of one day becoming a hunter when he comes into possession of a skillbook.
But the skill is a level 0. Something unheard of. No one wants it. People laugh at it. But he learns the skill – only to find that it may be the most amazing one yet.

5907.synopsis:
Song Zhong’s parents were the geniuses of the sect. But they were apparently killed while on a mission when he was barely 6. As he apparently did not excel in any of the 5 elements, in fact, all 5 elements are in balance in his body. Thus, our fatty is deemed to be tr*sh and does not deserve the respect his parents had.
He is allowed to have one task, to collect garbage of the sect until he reaches the initial test-age where he has to prove that he is worthy to stay in the sect.
Our fatty has no choice but to cultivate the only heritage his parents gave him. A mysterious black pearl.
Unfortunately for him, this pearl seems to be only useful for… collecting garbage…

6931.synopsis:
After hatching endless plots and suffering innumerable hardships, the demons of the Demonic Realm finally managed to resurrect the Ancient Demon King.
The demons of the Demonic Realm had hoped that the Ancient Demon King would not only lead them in waging a war against the Heavenly Realm and enable them to lord their superiority over the Immortals, he would also ultimately gain control over the entire realm.
Gradually, however, they discovered that their thoughts were very, very wrong.
Whilst it is true that this Ancient Demon King still retains his aura of superiority and possesses unlimited powers, he…
He seems to be a mental case…
It’s alright even if he changes orders and does things in an incomprehensible way.
But what’s with his habit of muttering under his breath, nagging and conversing with himself the entire day!
Small Orchid: He’s not ill, he’s just despicable (贱jian)…can’t stand to see (见jian) people live a good life.
Dong Fang: I am only unable to endure seeing you live a good life.
Small Orchid: …
*T/N: The Chinese pronunciation for the word “despicable” is the same as the word “see” – thus, the author is trying to show that Small Orchid, while trying to scold Dong Fang, is also careful not to incur his wrath, which is why she tried to imbue another meaning into her sentence after scolding him.
associated_names: ของรักของข้า

9491.synopsis:
The legendary tale of the Xyrin Empire is not about its struggles… or the tempest of another world or some cultivation myth. This is a super-serious, super-hard sci-fi novel about saving the world.
Take what I’m saying seriously…
Not.
Okay, this is just a funny story about a deceptive human emperor, bringing his bunch of slippery alien leaders to have fun saving the world every day.
Chen Jun is an unmotivated otaku who turns into the Emperor of an ancient intergalactic magic sci-fi empire. With the aura of a stay-at-home dad, he is nothing but a middle-aged man who adopts a group of lolis… and an army of freeloading aliens that came out of nowhere. Er, what?
Ahem. Really though, this is a super-serious story… a super-mega-ultra-serious sci-fi story.
For the Empire!

10515.synopsis:
“Did I transmigrate to another world? Am I a butterfly?”
“Oh god! This is too much!”
“Ehhh? Becoming an Immortal? In this chaotic and competitive world? A world filled with many handsome boys?”
“Haha, at least I have a celestial farmland inside me! Yes, I will just look for more seeds to plant more celestial plants.”
The story is set in a fantasized dimension where people have the urge to become Immortals through various training of celestial martial arts.
Qian Qian wakes up and realizes that she has transmigrated to a completely different world, where she is no longer a human, but instead, a Butterfly!
Her journey to becoming a powerful Immortal becomes smoother with the celestial farmland inside her!
The story takes on a similar genre to the popular drama like “Journey of a Flower” and “Eternal Love”.
Let us begin our journey into the Xianxia World!

11539.synopsis: Multi-Intellectual monster Zhuge performed star sacrifice to continue his life, the star falls on Wuzhang plain, the strand of Zhuge soul didn’t extinguish, crossed over to the outskirts of the Tianyun Continent, takes possession on the body of somewhat dull child…. And see how Zhuge proficient in astronomy and geography, ancient Chinese divination, a Military Adviser, creates a legend in a different world.

12819.synopsis:
The story follows Lana, who lives in a country where every person is granted a skill by the queen on their 15th birthday. Lana is given the skill “Breathing” (Kokyū), a skill he has never heard of, but he has always dreamed of diving into a dungeon as an adventurer.
The skill is basically a joke and initially seems to only do what it sounds like: allow Lana to breathe. Initially he plans to give up his dream, but then decides to challenge the dungeon anyway in order to rescue his sister, who is currently asleep under a witch’s curse. Lana has one year to reach the bottom level of the dungeon where the cure lies.
Lana is determined to reach the bottom even without the benefit of a skill, but what he doesn’t know is that he actually was gifted the strongest skill “Kami Kokyū” (God Breathing).
associated_names: Kami Skill "Kokyuu" Suru Dake de Level Up Suru Boku wa, Kamigami no Dungeon e Idomu.
神スキル【呼吸】するだけでレベルアップする僕は、神々のダンジョンへ挑む。

15379.synopsis:
Prometheus, the infinite fortress of time, a crossover point for the infinite worlds of machine wars, Our protagonist, Xiao Ran, was put into great pressure due to having only attributes that do not exceed 10, making him as weak as a chicken. But being familiar with the storyline of each mission world, Xiao Ran exclaimed that the world would be his.
========== ========== ========== ==========
Mission world: “Gundam SEED” -> “Macross F” -> “Gundam 00” -> “Ultimate Mission” -> “Kakumeiki Valvrave”-> “Gundam 0079” -> “Gundam Seed Destiny” -> “Super Robot Wars OG”

16147.synopsis:
The new VRMMORPG takes the world by storm with its 100% realism, set by the ancient legends of China. It quickly became known as the 2nd reality of mankind. Imagine fighting alongside legends such as Zhao Yun or Guan Yu or even having a stroll with the famous Diao Chan!
*Zhao Yun, Guan Yu, and Diao Chan are all famous historical figures back in the Three Kingdoms era of China

16915.synopsis:
After crossing over to another world which seemed to be a fusion between many anime worlds, The Fantasy System was unlocked for Mu Fan. After finishing the tasks given by the system, Fantasy points are given which allows him to gain access to the Fantasy store that was full of daily talents and more.
Yuuki Asuna: You know how to cook a lot of dishes. Can you teach me?
Sagiri: I don’t know anyone called Eromanga-Sensei.
Many more characters and interesting plots await us.

17171.synopsis:
Tao Wen transmigrated and discovered that he had become the brutal s*um lover in a tragic novel that he had just read.
That s*um character was a prince who, instead of living a luxurious life in peace, always made trouble for his brother, the emperor. His reckless behavior made him fall out with his secret guard who died trying to protect him. In the end, he regretted causing the death of his lover but it was too late. He was killed by the emperor.
Tao Wen thought that if he was that prince, he would never treat his lover like that…

17939.synopsis:
I’ve encountered my ideal protagonist!
It’s my friend, Hinomori Ryuuga. We’ve become the closest of friends after entering high school.
My first impression of Ryuuga was “This is the kind of protagonist you’d see in something like an anime.” Then, that thought soon changed into conviction.
First of all, this guy almost never talks about his past. Also, he frequently slips out of class. As soon as he comes back, he gets extremely tired, blood comes out from his lips, the sleeves and cuffs of his uniform get torn, and so forth.
Furthermore, there’s always beauties that are surrounding Ryuuga. The one who’s like an idol within the school, Yukimiya Shiori. The cool expert of the sword, Aogasaki Rei. The mysterious transfer student, Elmira McCartney. It’s very tiring for me when these people appear in front of Ryuuga. I have to frantically make a fuss by saying things like “H, hey Ryuga! How did you get acquainted with Yukimiya!”, “W, why did the beautiful swordswoman Aogasaki come to the classroom to specifically meet Ryuga?!”, or “E, E, Elmira! What is it that you see in Ryuga!”
…So why am I doing this? That’s because I, Kobayashi Ichirou, am a pro at being a friend.
My life’s calling is to support Hinomori Ryuuga, the protagonist amongst protagonists, as a close friend character.
―Let the curtains open for the rom-com presented by co-starring best friend, Kobayashi Ichirou!
associated_names: Is it Tough Being a Friend?
Yuujin Character wa Taihen desu ka?
Yuujin Kyara wa Taihen desu ka?

19987.synopsis:
He Bai won the lottery, became rich, and reached the pinnacle of life. Then, he inadvertently took a picture of the Film Emperor Di Qiuhe being killed. And after reporting this case to the police, he was reborn in a midst of confusion.
He Bai: I don’t have any horrible relatives to ab*se. Why was I reborn?
Di Qiuhe: But I do.
He Bai: I also haven’t been betrayed or harmed by anyone. Why was I reborn?
Di Qiuhe: But I have.
He Bai: I just want to have some money to live freely and eat well. I already achieved that goal, so why was I reborn?
Di Qiuhe: I have money, but don’t live freely or well.
He Bai angrily flips the table: So what’s the use of my rebirth! Just to make me suffer again?!
Di Qiuhe (Holding and Touching He Bai): Be my lover, you’re only responsible for eating “lollipops,” you won’t eat any bitterness.
He Bai: Leave!
associated_names: Một Lần Trọng Sinh Vô Tác Dụng

24083.synopsis:
Baibalon, a territory considered the worst in the country. A place where those who have no home left flee to, filled with criminals, heretics, sick people and demihumans.
Taking over the family as the next Lord, the young Rize Baibalon will try his best to stay alive in this god-forsaken place, not worrying if what he does to achieve that goal is going against the very founding doctrine of the country.
With little common sense and recovery magic, can he accomplish his peace? Or will the misunderstandings continue to pile up and will he be branded as a Rebel?

25107.synopsis:
Death started her on the road of book transmigration. 
Transmigrating into different supporting females, snatching opportunities and men from the different worlds’ female leads’ hands. 
Hey, Female Lead, you can have the male lead, the supporting male is the one I want. 
Walking on this endless road, Xia Qiu did not expect that during these countless book transmigrations, the one she saved has always been the same person. He’s from outer space, trapped in the stream of time, with only a robot for company. 
Meeting her, falling for her… 
However the sweetness isn’t easy. With a Boss as her man, Xia Qiu has a lot of worries. 
The Boss wants to bring me along as he destroys the earth, what should I do?
associated_names: 快穿之女配掰开也是黑的

26643.synopsis:
[Hello, host, I am the “heart of loyal servant” system from the three thousand world, numbered A007.]
“Hello, A007. My name is Mei Lu, a maid.”
[The host is the one I found in the three thousand worlds that best meets the conditions of this system. As long as you complete the tasks assigned to you by the clients through the system and earn enough energy, in return, the system will realize any of your wishes. Would you like to bind with me?]
“Bound to you, can you help me find the owner?”
[Of course. As long as there is enough energy, all demands of the host can be realized.]

27667.synopsis:
A mysterious island where there were 7 dungeon, when someone conquered all of them the goddess would granted their one and only wish whatever it was.
On the island, where a number of adventurers compete, there was, for some reason, a Level 1 boy with luggage.
He had a serious and hard-working personality that the goddess gave him an ultimate skill.
It was only now that he was glad with his luggage.
Because of his effort by utilizing the skill given by the Goddess, he finally break through the level 2 barrier running on his way to the strongest.
associated_names: Eldias Road ~ Megami ni Aisareta Shounen wa, Kyuukyoku Skill wo Soui Kufuu Shite Eiyuu e ~

エルディアス・ロード ～女神に愛された少年は、究極スキルを創意工夫して英雄へ～

27923.synopsis:
“Don’t come just to give me spirit energy as if it’s fodder”
Called by a mysterious voice, unconscious Ryuusei Moriya wakes up in an unfamiliar place.
It was Elman, a country in another world where dragons soar in the sky and a dragon king ruled.
“According to an ancient contract, you have to live as consort to the dragon king….”, was what he was told. And then, a crimson-haired dragon king, Fei Wan, appeared before a confused Ryuusei.
But what’s this, he looks like a small/little child..!
Because the king is deficient of [Spirit energy] which is a life nourishment that only Ryuusei can provide through physical contact, he has degenerated and remains in a child’s form even though he’s an adult.
Conspiracy over the throne, Bond between master and servant, a mysterious death in the past, a fated mate’s love!
associated_names: Sora ni hibiku no wa ryu no utagoe
The Dragon's Song is Ringing in the Sky

28179.synopsis:
Xing Ye couldn’t accept the sudden death of his younger brother, and as he searched for answers, he recalled the QR code he once saw on his brother’s phone. Having a photographic memory, he was able to quickly sketch out the QR code. Upon scanning it with his phone, he then finds himself transported to an all-white room, where, at the very middle, a giant cube was afloat.
Xing Ye then learned that his brother was a player in this Game of Challenging Fate, and to learn how his brother died, he signed himself up to it.
Later, he gets ahold of a sentient mirror, and the very existence of it hints at the truth of what this Game is really about.
associated_names: QR CODE เกมท้าลิขิต พิชิตชะตา
帰り道に行き倒れ吸血鬼が居たので助けたらヤンデレになった

30995.synopsis:
In 9012, the world became a high-temperature melting furnace, animals and plants died, urban infrastructure was paralyzed, water and electricity were cut off, the world became a large-scale hunger arena.
Su Mian was reborn three months before the end of the world, and accidentally got a scarlet jade gourd, which opened the planting space.
She resolutely ended her college course, returned to her hometown to farm, and built up high walls to resist the famine era.
After the end of the world, the major hidden families had come out of the mountain.
Luo Hansheng, the first person who came out, was ruthless and unkind. No one knew that he had been having the same dream for years, in that dream, he spoiled a woman almost insanely, and then the woman stabbed him and ran away.
The man sneered. When he found this woman, he would definitely cramp her and make her feel ashamed.
Later, the man found Su Mian in the cliff hole of Xiaoshan Village and coaxed her, “Follow me, I can give you everything you want ~”

32531.synopsis:
A soldier from a different world with a Japanese memory. Being beaten by an orc club, he regains his memory of his previous life and survives the world of war despite the confusion. 
Leverage your lack of presence. Let’s shake off the unfavorable things of the previous life and this world. 
From the third son of the Baron family to a senior aristocrat. Light territory management and special pets. The protagonist is not the strongest. 
Magic exists, but the protagonist cannot use it. It is a world where God exists. There is also gore. -Matteus-
associated_names: Tensei Shitara Heishi Datta? Akai Shinigami to Yobareta Otoko
転生したら兵士だった？！〜赤い死神と呼ばれた男〜

33043.synopsis:
The Wanderers came to this world from another, from Japan. However, due to global disasters caused by the reckless behavior of Wanderers in the past, the Executioner must kill them as soon as they’re found.
One day, the Executioner, Menou, meets a lost girl, Akari. Menou carries out her mission calmly and without hesitation. However, for some reason, Akari, whom she surely killed, resurrects without a care in the world. At a loss, Menou tricks the immortal Akari into coming along on a journey to find a way to kill her, but…
“Menou. Let’s go!”
”Yes yes yes. I understand.”
Menou‘s mind begins to waver a little as she faces the strangely relaxed Akari.
— this is the story of how she’s going to kill her.
associated_names: Shokei Shoujo no Ikiru Michi ―Soshite, Kanojo wa Yomigaeru―

33555.synopsis:
Zhang Guo Qing, an orphan in the 21st century, and his pregnant wife, Zhou Jiao, are struggling and working hard for their future when suddenly they receive a shocking inheritance. Just as they were rushing to the hospital to give birth, a premeditated car crash kills them and the couple gets sent back to the end of the 1950’s in the Northeast farmlands of China where they are reborn into the bodies of a young couple and the start of a heartwarming story begins to unfold. 
Zhou Jiao asks Zhang Guo Qing: “How will we survive the next bitter days with our son?” 
Zhang Guo Qing: “Don’t be afraid, I have golden fingers, I will make sure the two of you will eat deliciously and drink spicily.”

33811.synopsis:
I wasn’t able to overcome the harassment and took my life, but I was reincarnated with the perpetrator? The perpetrator is the heroine, Florre, and I am the villainess, Dahlia, who’s going to die horribly. 
“They said you are a villain with neither blood nor tears, but unlike the rumors, you often shed tears.”
“Your Highness must believe all the nonsense the idiots are talking about, huh?”
Grand Duke of Cervian, the half brother of the Male lead and who will be punished for treason afterwards. He approached me. I can’t lose the man who will be my greatest ally. 
“Your Highness, would you marry me?”
“Now…… what did you say?”
“And take revenge together.” 
A similar situation, a fixed ending. The heroine is not the only one who knows the ending of the novel. I took a long and arduous path of revenge.

35091.synopsis: An innocent girl who trusted him a lot! He said if she could help him detoxify, he would marry her…

35347.synopsis:
The game is over, but the ending is bad. 
The end of mankind. Only one player survived. 
At the moment it was all over, humanity’s final player received a message. 
[DLC shop opens after clearing all single modes.]

35603.synopsis:
Li Jiao was admitted to college, but her family feared that their little girl would get ruined by a pig of a man. But who would’ve thought that she would’ve gotten a boyfriend just immediately after military training. He was a special forces soldier that had come to training camp to help direct for a few days. 
He was cold and handsome, with an overload of aloof temperament. After knowing that he had no girlfriend, her journey to chasing her future husband began. 
But while chasing love for the first time, various deterrents had appeared in her way.
While doing push-ups, she had accidentally thrown her body down because of exhaustion, yet he thought that she was trying to infuriate him. Walking forward, she had accidentally kicked her shoe out and almost hit him, which he considered as revenge. Listening to a lecture, she had not stood firm because of her love for looking at her handsome crush. As a result, she had to kneel down in a spot of a lecture hall in front of thousands of people.
Li Jiao: “Speaking honestly, I’m not embarrassed. I just want to die.”
She originally thought that she had no hope of getting a boyfriend, but who would have thought…
Her shoes flew. He picked them up.
“These are Cinderella shoes, wear them.”
Seeing that she was getting faint, he stood behind her to provide shade.
The instructor of another class brought a piece of watermelon, but he didn’t hold it and instead passed it to her. After a while, he said:
“Li Jiao, I order you to eat the watermelon.”
“Okay.”
Zhang Jiuling had never expected to meet such a person. As long as she was coquettish, he would want to give her his life. 
“If your method of defeating your opponent is to be coquettish, then I wouldn’t even be able to lift my weapon.”
“I love my country, and I also love her. For the rest of my life, I’ll be loyal to my country, and I’ll devote myself to her.”
Note : Military training is optional in China, but it’s recommended. Students can choose to join and go to military training.

36371.synopsis:
Lu Shenxing was selected by the system 222 to travel through worlds to change the tragic fate of others.
At the same time, a door was also obtained. You can play in the door as much as you want.
But one day, Lu Shenxing discovered that the door he obtained was getting smaller and smaller, and he felt the malice of the universe.

37139.synopsis:
“You were born for the sake of Prince Vincent.”
Lenoir, who was born to be the prince’s retainer, received a curse in place of his best friend that transformed him into a woman.
And what’s more, the prince, who used to hate women, decided to take responsibility for what happened to his best friend, Lenoir, by marrying him!
This is the love story of a genderbent heroine who was engaged to her best friend, the prince.

37907.synopsis:
The moment I was at the peak of my career as a makeup YouTuber, I possessed someone: the female lead’s stepmother, a genius villain of magic tool-making.
“I was worried that I might have a different mind, but that’s fortunate.” 
It didn’t matter that he was the monstrous prince. It is just a contract marriage meant to connect the male and female leads anyway.
One year after the contract was broken, and after enduring numerous misunderstandings. Calypse left the estate. The makeup tool business was successful, and there were two handsome men who were obsessed with her. 
But he, who became emperor, is crazy and searching the whole country to find me. “What about the ‘original girl’? Why me?”

39443.synopsis: Jung Soon-won, one of Korea’s top combat wizards in 2030. After waiting for his death after losing the battle against the Queen of Flames, he turned back time due to a gift from the Fairy King. But 30 years? 30 years? He has to start again in the second year of middle school!

40211.synopsis:
Fang Shan is a system, one day on a mission to find the wrong host after getting drunk. 
As the future heir of the Wei family, Wei Su Shen has a ruthless attitude and is a big brother sought after by countless people.
Until one day – 
[ Fang Shan: Although you are just a rookie today, you can still soar into the nine heavens tomorrow! ]
Wei Su Shen: …… 
[ Fang Shan: I guarantee that those who looked down on you and persecuted you in the past will all pay the price! ]
Wei Su Shen: …… 
Later, Wei Su Shen, who was already at the top of his life, was forced to stand at the top of the world. 
[Fang Shan: Now dear host, please shout our slogan in front of everyone!] 
Wei Su Shen: …… Don’t, don’t discriminate against a poor young man.
Crowd: No! Shame!!!

40723.synopsis:
Makoto, who was raised by his father, a Kashima Shinto-ryu instructor, and mother, who comes from a family of Onmyoji, has chuunibyou (8th grade syndrome)?
There was a reason why his actions seemed chuuni.
Makoto proceeded through an ancient temple’s underground passage to its idol during his school trip, and as he passed through the door…
The world that was beyond him was the Sengoku period!?
Is this time traveling? What will happen to Makoto after he meets Nobunaga?
Can Oda Nobunaga, who understood that the world was round, understand Makoto’s time travel?
Isn’t Oda Nobunaga a super high-intellect boss? Are the Oda troops a black company? If you talk to Nobunaga, he’s surprisingly a nice person.
This is a story of a high school student from the Heisei era where Oda Nobunaga valued his delusional power, imagination, and wisdom to succeed in life.
Fried food, pork cutlet, curry rice. Heisei cuisine that fascinates Sengoku warlords and a dream harem life?
Advancing in the world with iron warships?
Make Oda Nobunaga the supreme ruler of the world with his future knowledge?
Develop his birthplace, Ibaraki, as Japan’s second-biggest urban area?
A new culture blooms from Makoto’s 2D bishoujo moe girl hobby?
A history-altering fantasy beyond your belief!
associated_names: Honnouji kara Hajimeru Nobunaga to no Tenka Touitsu
本能寺から始める信長との天下統一

42259.synopsis:
The childhood friend who finally reunited with me had turned into a total smoke show—classy and drop-dead gorgeous.
“It’s been a while, Hayato.”
“Wait… Haruki? Is that really you?”
Back in the day, Hayato used to get covered in mud playing together with Haruki in the countryside. Now that they’ve crossed paths again, there’s zero trace of that tomboyish brat he totally thought was a dude. She looks like a literal angel now, the kind of girl who turns every head in the room—but that’s just for show. The second she is alone with Hayato, Haruki drops the act and goes right back to being the same loudmouth she always was. Even the way she gets all up in his space hasn’t changed a bit.
“Taking off your socks and sitting cross-legged like that… I can see everything, you know.”
“Oh, you wanna peek, huh?”
“No, I don’t!”
“Then just look away. Or… is there something else on your mind? Heh.”
“D*mmit, it’s not like that!”
“Hehe.”
Getting played like that all the time was getting on Hayato’s nerves and making Hayato all flustered. So, Hayato decided to start treating Haruki like an actual girl for once, and the reaction Hayato got was… totally unexpected.
The countryside and the big city.
A boy and a girl.
Hearts and bodies that have changed.
Yet feelings and promises that stay the same.
Plus, a reunion with Hayato’s little sis’ bestie from back in the village, and a meeting with a girl from the Gardening Club who’s all about growing veggies. And then—
This is a story about a childhood friend, slowly closing the gap and making up for the lost time, all starting from one particular summer.
associated_names: Oh Boy, Was I Wrong About Her (WN)

転校先の清楚可憐な美少女が、昔男子と思って一緒に遊んだ幼馴染だった件 (WN)

45587.synopsis:
“I’ve come for my son.”
Just before she was sold to an old lord, Adele spent a night with a stranger. She ended up pregnant with the child of a wandering knight whose name she didn’t even know.
And now, four years later. 
The messenger of the battlefield, the cruel butcher Vanhelm Von Alfred…
The man who appeared as an Emperor wanted only her child. 
Adele was taken with him to protect her beloved young son.
But in the suffocating, prison-like imperial palace, she was confronted with a reality she had never expected. 
“I am the one who will be your mother. Your Highness Leo.”
A woman who dared to say she was the mother of Adele’s child. 
“It is foolish to spend your life in recklessness.” 
The Emperor’s strategist told Adele not to covet the Empress’s seat as it was something that a commoner like her shouldn’t have.
“From now on, you’re not allowed to leave the castle.”

“I will not let you go. Never.”
The emperor, who was cruel and cold, somehow became obsessed with Adele……. 
Adele’s life began to get caught up in a whirlwind of intense political strife. 
‘I want to be happy as a person, and I want to love as a woman.’
She wished. In the Imperial Palace where she would live in the future….

47379.synopsis:
Cheon Yeo-woon, the Lord of the Sky Demon Order.
An unfortunate accident caused him to stumble into a distant future.
The GATE is open and he struggles to get back to the past from the chaotic future.

49939.synopsis:
As a man who has been devastated and robbed of his fiancee by his own brother, Fu Fengcheng plans to take revenge to the world.
He then married a woman named Leng Sa.
Fu Fengcheng: Since I’m already in hell,then I want everyone to go down with me!
Leng Sa: Why?
Fu Fengcheng: I want to get rid of all the people who stand in my way!
Leng Sa : Are you talking about me?

Leng Sa: Go and take your medicine.

51987.synopsis:
Shou Xu Nuo wakes up one day to find a handsome and yandere man where his bed should be. As Xu Nuo tries to navigate life while being tossed around by this supernatural man, he discovers that something is not quite right. Who is this man and why does he seem so familiar? When he tries to remember just what it was he had forgotten, things go horribly wrong.
“My beloved, I will sleep by you. This is our love nest…and our grave.”

53779.synopsis:
When the Main God Space was destroyed, Mo Xiao, the reincarnator, taken away by the unknown light ball, entered the new world and found that he became Kurumi Tokisaki!
The first world: Highschool of the Dead, the second world: Apocalypse Summoner, the third world: Marvel Universe, the fourth world: Fate/Zero, the fifth world: Battle Through the Heavens, The sixth world: ???, The seventh world: Strike the Blood, the eighth world: Re:Zero, the ninth world: Overlord, The tenth world: ???, The eleventh world: Swallowed Star.

54035.synopsis:
The Infinite Survival System suddenly appeared on Planet Blue. Those who are chosen are forced to survive in dungeons.
The Survivors can continue to grow stronger if they survive the dungeon missions. However, just one failure and it would be their deaths.
Every Survivor gets a talent. Some talents can boost the Survivor’s agility, and some enhances their luck, while Zhou Chen’s talent was Passive Plunderer. It allows him to plunder the passive skills of the monsters he hunts.

54803.synopsis:
Chai Meicen, a single mother, has a handsome son who’s a bit of a handful.
One morning, she wakes up to find herself transformed back into her sixteen-year-old self! Her beauty is still intact, she hasn’t gained a pound, and her hair is as thick and gorgeous as ever.
With ample time and money, she makes a bold decision: transfer to her son’s school and become his classmate, hoping to steer him onto the right path.
Zhou Rui fears nothing in heaven or on earth—except his mother! He’s endured countless boasts about her legendary beauty in her youth.  But suddenly, those stories become reality when his mother reverts to her sixteen-year-old self. And damn, is she stunning!
After a period of adjustment, she realizes she can’t change back. On a whim, she enrolls in his school and becomes his classmate?!
As a result…
The school’s notorious bad boy, whose very name sends shivers down spines, gets a taste of his own medicine when the newly transferred school beauty slaps him and orders him to do his homework.
Under her watchful eye, Zhou Rui—with a forced smile—declares to the entire school, “From now on, I will diligently study and strive for progress every day, with the goal of becoming a scientist!”
Zhou Rui issues a final warning: “Anyone who dares to pursue her will face the same wrath as if they’d cursed me directly.”
associated_names: Back to School, Back in Time: A Mother's Teenage Do-Over

55059.synopsis:
It has been five years since an Omega held a post in the military of the Empire. After all, the delicate and soft Omegas are obviously not suited for the tough military system. Until one day, the Imperial Navy with an Alpha-Omega ratio of nearly 99:1, appeared a freshman like Lu Jingning, who directly overwhelmed a group of seniors in a competition on the first day of school. 
The whole school was shocked, this Omega was as explosive as an Alpha! Lu Jingning, the Demon King of Chaos and Light amidst the sea, Emperor Wen Xingchen became the two great legends of the Imperial Navy. During the military school league, the two teamed up and infiltrated deep into the enemy camp, directly obliterating the strongholds of other schools. 
Everyone was very curious, if these two get into a fight, who will come out stronger?
One day, Lu Jingning blocked Wen Xingchen in the corridor and stretched his neck in front of him. “Come, take a bite. Be good and mark me,” he said.
Wen Xingchen: “I’m happy to help.”
Many years later-
Wen Xingchen: “Why did you choose me?”
Lu Jingning: “Do you want to hear the truth?”
Wen Xingchen: “Speak.”
Lu Jingning: “Of course it’s because you are the first person who didn’t kneel when you smelled my pheromones.”
Wen Xingchen: “?”
Lu Jingning’s quote: if you smell my pheromones but don’t kneel, count me as the loser~

55315.synopsis:
When Su Jinyu held Gu Peilang’s bloody corpse, he still couldn’t react. He couldn’t believe that the man who was supposed to spend his honeymoon with his newlywed wife in the United States would appear in front of him covered in blood, protect him from an explosion with his broken body, and fight for him. After the aftermath of the explosion, he took his last breath in his arms because of excessive blood loss. Gu Yin, who came in a hurry, looked at the lost youth in the ruins. When he left with Gu Peilang’s body in his arms, he cursed at the person on the ground: “You will never realize how much he loved you, Su Jinyu.”
“Su Jinyu, just keep living like this, with the guilt towards him and the guilt of the Su family……..just…… keep on living.”

58131.synopsis:
Tao Anzhi: “Yan Xi, do you love me?”
Yan Xi: “Taotao, of course I love you.”
Tao Anzhi: “Then do you like me?”
Yan Xi: “Taotao… I can’t…”
associated_names: Peach And Plum Trees Don't Speak
The Silent Peach And Plum Blossoms

59667.synopsis:
In his last life, Lin Lang was once lost because of bullying. He delicately collided with him, he hit his body heavily on the ice, cut his calf with a sharp ice skate, and bloo-d spread on the ice. Because of this shadow , he stood still for three years, but when he came back, everything had changed. The bully took all the medals and had numerous fans.
He caught up and became a great devil in the skating field. However, he died suddenly in the competition field that was about to completely destroy him, and almost created the next era completely belonging to him.
Before he closed his eyes, he made a wish to the God, and asked to borrow another ten years to give him time to rise up again and defend his crown. After opening his eyes, everything went back to the year when he had just been bullied, and he had a new starting point that he could freely use—— Shen Lianqiu, as the best skate maker of the younger generation, met Lin Lang when he returned home. Once the fat child who dared not look up even when talking had grown into a young boy with a slim figure, but still with a wide hat, he was alone in a dark corner. As always, he was timid, as if nothing had changed except his body. Shen Lianqiu kept this idea until Lin Lang, who was reborn, took off his hat in front of him and set foot on the ice rink. Charming and dangerous, extreme and crazy. He had no sense of existence in peacetime. Lin Lang was the king who ruled everything on the court. No one could look at others without his permission.
The once-embryonic bird had long since metamorphosed, leaving behind only an eagle who could look out over the entire playing field with open wings.
associated_names: 重回十六岁的花滑大魔王
重回十六歲的花滑大魔王

59923.synopsis: Once she transmigrated over, Li Haitang, an elite female doctor from the big city, is demoted to a pitiful little cabbage whose parents have both died. She is surrounded by extreme jackals, wolves, tigers and panthers family and relatives. What? She is sold to a half-dead body that is going to be buried in the ground. Has she been sold to an old man with a heavy taste? The only way to escape from the arranged marriage is to pack a bundle wrapped in a cloth! Who would have thought that on the way to the wedding, she meets a wild man who is feared by everyone in the village? The wild man has three treasures, he is hardworking, spoils his wife and has good stamina! His pectoral muscles, abs and mermaid’s line are all there.

60435.synopsis:
Have you ever seen romance between a cherry man and a watermelon man,
you have not.
Earth’s doomsday, species mutation, geological calamities, a purgatory on earth
Humanity’s science and technology are already sufficiently developed. They’ve migrated to other planets, and even began to look behind for research…
A calm, intelligent machine VS a shamelessly reliable dage.

60691.synopsis:
Iris Lepos.
She was the queen of a fallen country. 
Hayer, her husband’s younger brother and her first love, came to her, who remained alone on the throne where even the king had fled. 
“Can you find the North Gate?” 
The Lepos were born with a map of the world in their heads and could find their way in the middle of the desert.
Iris, the heir to the throne, nodded. 
And the moment she crossed the North Gate through a severe snowstorm.
She realized. That she was back six years ago. 
“If something changes beyond the North Gate, don’t love me then. Never.” 
And knowing that she had the opportunity to save the man who died for her. 
“Promise me that you will help me avoid marriage that I don’t want.” 
Miraculously given a second chance.
To change her fate, this time she went to Hayer first. 
Will she be able to live as a king instead of a shadow queen?

63251.synopsis:
The first time Lu Jingyan met Sheng Xian, she only had one goal – to make him cry. 
But later, Lu Jingyan was the one who cried. 
… 
Lu Jingyan first met Sheng Xian at a bar. Her phone didn’t have reception so she asked him for his mobile hotspot. He told her the password is her birthday. 
Before she could enter the password, she was called away by someone else. She thought that he had a crush on her but the bore refused to accept any of her advances. It was after half a year did she realize his password is yourbirthday. 
…
The sweet love story between a stunning heiress and the youngest law professor.

63507.synopsis:
Consort Yi, who was breathtakingly beautiful and the most doted on in the imperial harem, had a nightmare about the future. 
The crown prince was deposed. The fourth prince ascended the throne. Her sworn enemy, Consort De, became the empress dowager. Her son, the fifth prince, was not allowed to have an important position. The ninth prince died while he was imprisoned. The eleventh prince died of an illness during infancy. Although Kangxi spoiled her with sweet words of love, he took in many women in his later years and cast her aside. 
Kangxi urged the new emperor that if Consort Yi was domineering and disrespectful after he passed away, then the new emperor did not need to take his feelings into consideration. 
In the end, she died in desolation. 
After awaking from her dream –  
Consort Yi: We are not going to bother. 
Whoever wants to be the favoured consort can go ahead and be the favoured consort! 
The emperor didn’t say anything, but knew deep down that out of all those in the imperial harem, only Consort Yi had his heart. 
She was beautiful, considerate, thoughtful, and knew how to handle various situations. Once in a while, she had a bit of a temper.  
But suddenly, one day, Consort Yi went on strike. In order to refuse his favour, she did everything she possibly could. 
Yun Xiu: I am jealous and malicious… 
Kangxi: ???
Note: this is based on the Qing dynasty
associated_names: Favoured Consort Goes on Strike Every Day

64531.synopsis:
It was 1068, Year 1 of the Xining era. Emperor Zhao Xu had recently ascended the throne of the Song dynasty. The widely respected old-guard of civil officials, Ouyang Xiu, Han Qi, and Fu Bi, were in their twilight years. The unorthodox reformer Wang Anshi was full of vigor, wishing to reverse the tide of decline sweeping over the empire. The stubborn Sima Guang would rather leave imperial government than give up on proper orthodoxy. The literary Su Shi watched from the sidelines, unable to pick a side. 
With such a talented crop of civil officials, the Song dynasty should have shone brightly. Instead, these geniuses embarked on a mutually destructive course, leaving the Song empire with a gaping, irreparable wound, and leaving future students of history with regret and controversy. 
But the sudden arrival of a junior lawyer opens a new path for the Song dynasty. Reformers and conservatives, civil and military officials, domestic and foreign affairs, all shall come under the Law.

64787.synopsis:
Sagami Asahi was a supporting character from the moment he was born. Attractive face and figure, doing well in both academics and sports​, high morals–my sister, Sagami Hanabi, who does everything perfectly compared to me, a mob. I’m such a failure, but for some reason I’m very popular with my sister’s friends……! Why is that…..!?
Spending days together with a gentle yandere older sister, a masculine and tsundere boyish senpai, and a straight-forward kuudere senpai, slowly unravels Asahi’s inferiority complex.
associated_names: モブの俺がなぜか姉の友達からやたらとモテる件について

67859.synopsis:
A certain man, for some reason, was reincarnated as the villainous noble, Jin Divinesword, in the immensely popular game “Brilliant Proof.”
As the second son of a renowned Swordmaster, Jin’s sword skills were anything but impressive, leading to his father’s disdain. To make matters worse, only death flags were waiting for him as the game’s antagonist.
However, the man reborn as Jin knew something– In place of talent for swordsmanship he had an unparalleled gift for magic that surpasses human imagination. Yet, he has no intention of exploiting his knowledge to seize power, nor does he desire to steal the game’s heroine away from the protagonist. All he desires is a peaceful life alongside his maid, Mea.
Yet, the course of the story doesn’t quite allow for such peace…
Embark on a journey into the world of this villainous aristocrat, as he longs for the tranquility of ordinary days with his loyal maid. Uncover the twists and turns that fate has in store for this unexpected hero.
associated_names: 平穏を望む剣術名家の悪役貴族〜史上最高の魔法の才を持った悪役キャラに転生したので、推しのメイドとの穏やかな生活を送るために最強になる〜

68371.synopsis:
The main character got reincarnated into a game that he doesn’t even know anything about other than the name, which resembles the name of his beloved game that he played more than anyone that he even remembers everything about it.
He doesn’t know the game’s genre or system, the characters, when the story begins, where it takes place, and he doesn’t even know his position in the game.
Even so, he desperately gathers information and somehow gains the conviction that he is the ‘protagonist of an academy romance RPG’.
In order to protect himself and the world, he goes through a series of out-of-the-ordinary training and confronts the original story!
associated_names: ミリしら転生ゲーマー　～1ミリも知らないゲームの世界に転生したけど全力で原作を守護ります～

69651.synopsis:
Song Ning reluctantly brushed his teeth in the bathroom, silently sighing at his reflection in the mirror. The naked man in the mirror was in his early twenties, with an average figure and no well-defined muscles. His pen*s was also lacking enthusiasm. As a college student, he was both a shut-in and a slacker. He spent his days playing on his phone and computer, either surfing the internet and playing games or being dragged around by his girlfriend for shopping trips. Yes, the ordinary Song Ning had a girlfriend, a fact that even his classmates found unbelievable. Although Song Ning’s girlfriend was just an unremarkable girl from the same school, it was quite rare in the current university campus, which was full of wolves and lacking flesh. Song Ning’s classmates made various speculations, such as being a “replacement” or having a “master’s task,” which became the talk of the town for quite some time.
“Honey, hurry up…” his girlfriend’s urging voice came from outside the bathroom.

69907.synopsis:
Lumer, a planet with a mysterious name, is a battlefield for countless monsters and powerful beings. This place, where endless battles rage on and the boundaries of the land seem to stretch into eternity, can truly be described as hell.
And I was just a mere human who had fallen into this hell. Among beings who could easily crush human bones and more, humans were nothing more than pitiful and feeble creatures.
I, Lee Seojun, was such a human.
“Fusion.”
I was nothing more than a human, but as an experiment, I possessed a unique ability. An ability to attach myself to another body, assimilate with it, and use a new body as my own.
“I survived.”
With that ability, I had to attach myself to the bodies of monsters and become one of them in order to survive.  And finally, I defeated a being that could be called the King of these monsters on the planet Lumer. Having survived, I took what the guy had.
[The system recognizes a new owner for the final boss, Aion.]
[The player returns to their original world.]
Now, I could go after them.

71699.synopsis:
[Fantasy + Single Female Lead + Contrary Female Lead + Dog Food]

No one expected that the first-generation prodigy goddess turned out to be a waste without any spiritual roots.

Now that my secret’s been discovered, I can finally be bullied with justification.

72723.synopsis:
After obtaining the coveted item in the MMORPG, the next moment, the protagonist’s life comes to an untimely end as he is swept away by a massive amount of water. 
However, the gods have not forsaken him. They decide to give him a second chance by reincarnating him into a world similar to the game, still possessing the stats and items he acquired.
This is the tale of a man who, while living the TUEEE life, stirs up a new breeze in a different world akin to a game.
associated_names: 独身貴族の異世界転生～ゲームの能力を引き継いで俺TUEEEチート生活

75027.synopsis:
Once again, when she opened her eyes, she had transformed into the ancient foolish lady, Chen Feng. 
Watching the hero who saves her, was as high and mighty as a god and also so handsome, Chen Feng drool from the corner of her mouth. 
In her previous life, she is lonely and unfortunate, but this time she is blessed.
This lifetime, she didn’t want to aim too high, this lifetime, she didn’t want to be unrealistic… 
She only wanted to live a good life and spends her time with her new found family.
However, in this lifetime, she was foolish but good-looking, poor but lucky, with so much good fortune that it couldn’t be exhausted.”
Tags: Strong Woman, Love Grows Over Time, Farming, Relaxed, Cozy

75283.synopsis:
I possessed a character with an intelligence of 100 in a classic medieval fantasy land-grabbing game.
An intelligence score of 100. That meant my predictions were always accurate.
However, since I was physically weak and didn’t quite understand why that was the case, I thought it best to just live quietly.
But then… leaders who began to recognize my ability started to become obsessed with me.

76307.synopsis:
Jin Seong-woon, an actor hated by everyone, suddenly found himself transformed into Ryu Chae-yoon, the beloved youngest son of a conglomerate family.
After tragically dying in a traffic accident, the Reincarnation Management Committee made some incomprehensible remarks about a ‘Soul Adjustment Project’ for Jin Seong-woon’s soul.
They threatened that if he didn’t fulfill Ryu Chae-yoon’s wish, he would return to the moment of his death.
In the process of inevitably completing the quest to grant Ryu Chae-yoon’s wish, Seong-woon becomes entangled with Baek Sang-hyun (Gong),
Ryu Chae-yoon’s wish was also related to Baek Sang-hyun…
What is the truth behind the relationship between Ryu Chae-yoon, Jin Seong-woon, and Baek Sang-hyun?

78099.synopsis:
Jung Hee-woo, an ordinary university student, her life took an unexpected turn when she got kidnapped by Il-gang because of her brother’s misdeeds.
To locate her brother, who had fled with the ledger that was kept as a secret, Hee-woo becomes a hostage to them.
Seo Soo-hyuk, the mafia boss of Il-gang, an underworld corporation, is a cold-blooded tyrant who doubts whether blood would truly be red if he were to cut his skin.
While her mind continues to wear down as she is endlessly exposed to violence and confinement, a mysterious connection starts to blossom with Seo Soo-hyuk, with whom she shares a close relationship…

79635.synopsis:
Qin Changqing traversed to a cultivation world.

Good news, after marrying into a cultivation family, his system, descendant strengthening system, was awakened.

associated_names: 修仙界：生存从让女人们怀孕开始

80915.synopsis:
Shou’s Perspective 
The Zombie King found a job that seemed to never end, becoming the boss of the infinite world.
But on his first day, he was kidnapped into the infinite world as a player by a strange, tall man who had no heartbeat. Since then, he was forced to flee with the strange man. In the next moment, he found himself transformed into that strange man’s wife.
“This is my wife, Jiang Shishi,” the strange man introduced him.
The strange man was dressed in a decent suit that did not fail to  highlight his handsome appearance. 
“Three years ago, she had a car accident, and since then, she’s been mentally confused and wants to bite everyone when she sees them. She always likes beautiful clothes, and her initial skill is to change clothes with one click.”
Thus, the newly crowned  Zombie King became ‘Jiang Shishi’.
The Zombie King couldn’t bear to hear the strange man’s words any longer. He opened his mouth and attempted to bite the man,
However, the bad guy’s skin was very hard and tough, and his teeth couldn’t break through it at all!!
“Shishi must behave like a good girl and absolutely not bite people!” The man smiled as he slowly pressed his cold lips against his ear, whispering like a lover, “If your mouth misbehaves, it’ll be tied up just like your legs. Okay?”
After enduring repeated beatings, the Zombie King found himself reduced to a state of mute and lame, akin to a powerless and incapacitated individual, forced to continue as the man’s submissive and voiceless spouse.
Gong’s Perspective 
When the King of Zombies broke away from the control of the infinite world, he accidentally brought out a beautiful little mute zombie with jade-like golden appearance. With time running out, he had no choice but to take this person with him.
To blend more safely into the infinite world, the Zombie King, dressed the little zombie in women’s clothes and presented them as husband and wife.
Carrying him along, their relationship evolved into one where they slept in the same coffin.
The cunning and sly King of Zombies (Attack, You Wusii) who loves to pretend and show off, possessing numerous secrets unknown to others, X the Zombie King (Jiang Shishi) who has no memory, no brains, and no inclination to think or learn, deceived by the main system to drain energy and work as a laborer.
Points to note:
Shou at initial stage was forced to act as women
Both Gong and Shou are king of Zombies but in different version. Like in game version 1.1 and version 2.1
associated_names: The love story between two zombies

81427.synopsis:
– Security Level 1 Unlocked. Level 1 weapon, ‘Rocket Punch’ has been used.
Yeong-sik stared at his right arm with a dumbfounded expression.
“…What?”
Rocket Punch?
He wasn’t leveling up like a machine.
He was becoming a machine!

81683.synopsis:
When I saw my stepsister bring the poor boy home first, I knew she had been reincarnated too.
In the last life, she replaced me and married into a wealthy family, while I married the poor boy, Fang Ze.
After marriage, my stepsister suffered domestic violence and miscarriage, and was framed by a mistress, ending up penniless. I stood by Fang Ze as he started from scratch, and he loved me deeply.
My stepsister was resentful and hit my pregnant self with a car…
Unexpectedly, we were both reincarnated.
In this life, my stepsister is eager to take over my life.
She thinks my good fortune is all because of Fang Ze.
And she’s right.
Fang Ze is indeed a rare talent and a perfect husband, while I am just waiting for him to do everything.
I was at a loss, but Fang Ze walked straight to me.
With a pitiful expression, he said, “Wife, why didn’t you come looking for me in this life?”

81939.synopsis:
Dark River, capable of assassinating royalty and nobility in court and wiping out powerful sects in the wild, is the most feared organization of assassins in the martial world. However, its leader, the Patriarch, is aging and gradually losing control. 
During a mission to kill Tang Clan’s Second Master, the Patriarch is severely injured. Several faction leaders within Dark River send out assassins to kill him, while he seeks physicians to prolong his life. This race against time, concerning life, death, and the future of the assassin organization, begins. 
Fate brings two young men, who crawled out of piles of corpses and share a deep bond, to stand on opposite sides…

Ancient-style ABO
Reticent rural husband alpha & down-on-his-luck young lord omega

98579.synopsis:
The novel constructs a fictional historical stage modelled after the Ming Dynasty’s “Tumu Crisis”. It begins with the “Wuying Western Campaign”, with the rise and fall of the “Jingtai Dynasty” and the Zhengtong Dynasty as its central narrative thread. Spanning fifty years, featuring over three hundred characters, and comprising more than four million words, the story revolves around the theme of “restoration”. Political upheavals compel each protagonist to face critical decisions—right and wrong, guilt and punishment, death and surrender. Their joys and sorrows, their trials of human nature, ultimately redefine the essence of heroism. This decade-long epic journey culminates in the spirit of “Hero’s Legends.”
The novel is divided into three parts:
1. The Jingtai Dynasty (Volumes 1-8: From “The Storm of Xiliang” to “Top of the Honour Roll”),
2. The War of Restoration (Volumes 9-15: From “The Divine Sword Captures the Dragon” to “The Iron Guard of the Nation”),
3. The Zhengtong Dynasty (Volumes 16-26: From “The Infernal Demon Blade” to “The Heroes Reunite”).
The first four volumes primarily introduce the four main protagonists: Yang Suguan, Qin Zhonghai, Lu Yun, and Wu Dingyuan.
– Wu Dingyuan, a head constable from Xiliang, pursues justice by investigating the massacre of the Yanling Escort Agency, only to become a target of various political forces.
– Lu Yun, having failed the imperial examination and wrongly imprisoned, remains steadfast in his ideals…
Eventually, the four protagonists converge in the capital, marking the beginning of their journey of growth and transformation.

Collapsed World 2: Cold and Aloof Genius and Arrogant School Bully: Are you being nice to me out of pity?
Collapsed World 3: Capital City’s Richest Man and Prodigal Prince: Can’t you live without a man?
Collapsed World 4: Demon Sect Disciple and Immortal Sect Master: Master, I’m in so much pain, can you really bear to kill me?
…….
While unfreezing her points, Wen Nuan discovered the plots were increasingly deviating from the original trajectory.
She couldn’t help but wonder again and again:
Why were the female leads constantly confessing to her?
Why were the male leads gradually losing their presence?
Why was the “her” in each world so familiar?
Until—
Wen Nuan opened her eyes once more, looked at the sleeping female lead in her arms, asked the system for aftercare items, lit a cigarette, and said in a deep voice: “System, why do I feel like… I’ve become gay?”
System: 【If this were the first time you told me this… I could still come up with an explanation for you.】
Wen Nuan paused: “I actually… didn’t intend for you to find an explanation for me being gay.”
【Then what are you telling me for?】
Wen Nuan said mischievously: “Showing off my love.”
【….】
“I’m tied to this world alone, how can we live together but not die together?”
Tsundere, All-Around, Secretly Flirty (攻) Wen Nuan VS The Birth of an Awakened One (Obsessive Crybaby, Seductive, 受)
Reading Guide:
1. Straight to Gay!
2. Most of the content is the author’s private setting, please don’t overthink it!
3. Characters from “Male Lead, Let Go of That Female Lead, Let Me Do It” will appear several times; there’s a crossover!
4. One of the protagonists is not the main god, as for what they are, you can collect this story and read along to explore!
5. Wen Nuan is a bit twisted, likes unorthodox methods, maximizes benefits, and seeks results that satisfy her, so she doesn’t care about the lives of others. She will gradually improve later (after all, Wen Nuan does quite a few bad things later on).
6. If any of you are triggered by this, we can meet in the next book.
associated_names: When the Heroine Becomes Paranoid (Quick Transmigration)

109587.synopsis:
One day, after crossing over, Ning Qi sought only immortality.
With innate spiritual radiance bestowed upon him, he awakened full-level comprehension.
From that moment on.
Ning Qi cultivated in seclusion, refusing to emerge unless he was unbeatable.
He read ten thousand scriptures to deepen his foundation, observed the heavens and earth to comprehend the Dao.
He created methods never seen before in ancient times, and opened a path unimaginable to people today.
The ancient saints awakened from the distant past, yet they did not know—
In this world, there now existed a truly invincible being.
…………
Ning Qi sat high above the heavens, preaching the Dao, raising the World Tree, and uplifting the world.
He said: “This realm shall have immortals.”  
The Great Dao manifested, and the world ascended.
All living beings paid homage, all creatures bowed their heads.
“Eternal Dao Ancestor!”
associated_names: Immortality Begins with Innate Bone Nourishing Technique
满级悟性：我以升格下界成就道祖
长生从先天蕴骨功开始

110355.synopsis:
In a world where martial might decides life and death, Gu Mo—a blind young man—emerges from the shadows with nothing but a blade, a sister, and a system that promises the ultimate power. Betrayed by the escort agency he once bled for and cast aside as useless, Gu Mo stumbles upon a mystical inheritance: the legendary Nine Yang Divine Skill—at full mastery.
Now armed with inner power that regenerates endlessly and a system that rewards him for capturing the most dangerous criminals in the jianghu, Gu Mo takes up a new path: the path of a Bounty Hunter.
His first targets? Vicious mu*derers. Infamous fugitives. Demon cult scum.
His weapons? A broken past. A cold blade. And a system that offers martial arts techniques once thought lost to time.
But in the ruthless world of wandering blades and buried grudges, the blind cannot survive on strength alone. Gu Mo must cut through the lies, fight through ambushes, and rise from the ashes—one bounty at a time.
Enemies beware: this blind man sees more than most.
associated_names: 瞎子捉刀人：开局满级九阳神功

111379.synopsis:
Chi Yueshan, from the Lower World, has three dreams:
1. Get into Guyun Academy and save up enough for tuition.
2. Win the love of her childhood savior, Wen Xinghuo.
3. Become the galaxy’s number one mecha master.
She managed to earn her tuition by fleecing a rich sucker as a 1-on-1 streamer, only to find out her savior already has a rumored girlfriend.
This rumored girlfriend is the academy’s dream Omega, a top-tier noble lady—gorgeous as a goddess, yet insufferably arrogant. To win Wen Xinghuo’s heart, Chi Yueshan must take down her rival.
Every year, the academy holds a compatibility test for Alphas and Omegas. Those with a high match rate are encouraged to consider marriage. Chi Yueshan waits with bated breath, hoping for a perfect match with Wen Xinghuo.
The result…
She and her rival, the Omega Xi Zhoumeng, are a 100% match?!
And to her shock, the rich sucker she fleeced for tuition money turns out to be none other than this very rival.
Amidst the thunderous announcement of “Please marry on the spot!”
Chi Yueshan despairs: Who wants to marry this Mary Sue princess!
—
The naturally frigid Xi Zhoumeng has transmigrated into a book, becoming a cannon fodder female supporting character who, despite having Alpha genes, tests as an Omega.
But with her stunning looks, pampered nature, and top-tier family background, no one suspects she’s an Alpha.
In the book, she was insidious and cruel. Her obsessive love for the protagonist, Wen Xinghuo, led to her downfall, the ruin of her family, and her own exile to a desolate planet.
Xi Zhoumeng has zero interest in the protagonist, Wen Xinghuo, but to follow the plot, she must act madly in love.
She never expected that at the new year’s A/O compatibility test—
She and a fellow cannon fodder female supporting character, the freshman Omega Chi Yueshan, would be a 100% match???
With the background sound of “marry on the spot” playing,
Xi Zhoumeng thinks: Oh well, I guess I can make do.
But she doesn’t realize that her life as a lazy, coasting noble lady is gone for good.
Not only must she fight the Zerg, but she also becomes the galaxy’s number one commander.
The journey from a slacker to a career-driven powerhouse often just takes one mark, one knot.
And a fiery wife that someone who swore they’d rather die than have kids has to accept.
Xi Zhoumeng: I don’t want to work, I want to lie down.
Chi Yueshan: Then you lie down. I’ll go find another rising star.
Xi Zhoumeng: Nooo, I’m going to work right now, sob sob sob.
associated_names: My Omega Rival and I Are 100% Compatible

112659.synopsis:
That girl—Miyagi—is strange. Once a week, she pays me 5,000 yen to buy the right to command me.
Whether it’s playing video games together, feeding me snacks, or sometimes making slightly dangerous requests depending on her mood… it’s already been half a year since we started sharing this secret.
Yet she still says, “We’re not friends.”
Hey, Miyagi—if this isn’t friendship, then what are we?
 That girl—Sendai-san—there was never a particular reason it had to be her.
It just started from a whim of mine, and she happened to go along with it.
That’s all.
So I test her again today—the girl who never refuses my commands.
I wonder… if we’re put in different classes next spring, will she still want to continue this relationship?
Lately, that thought lingers in my mind just a bit.
associated_names: 週に一度クラスメイトをかう話

113683.synopsis:
Qin Yi, an ancient eunuch, was executed by Lingchi (death by a thousand cuts) after a failed attempt to seize the throne. He is reborn as Qin Yi, a timid and weak-willed extra actor.
Reborn, he regains the treasures he lost in his previous life and vows to live with self-respect and dignity.
Xiao Jingmao, a wealthy and powerful third-generation military officer, is utterly corrupt and desperately needs an experienced eunuch to mentor him.
Watch as the eunuch turns the tables and creates a superstar.
associated_names: The Treacherous Eunuch Becomes a Superstar

115475.synopsis:
Urgent! What should I do if I put on a human skin mask and now can’t take it off? And my body keeps turning more and more feminine!
Even worse, this human skin mask looks exactly like our sect’s peerless fairy!
associated_names: 仙子，我真不是你的分身啊

115987.synopsis:
It’s okay if you only like my body. It’s okay if you don’t love me.
Just let me stay by your side.
* * *
Katia, who works as an aide, fell in love with the kind and gentle Crown Prince.
Her one-sided love shatters into pieces when the Crown Prince gets a lover.
And the man who introduced her to the lover—Leonid, the Crown Prince’s guard captain—
suddenly began approaching Katia.
“What do you think about being there for each other when we’re lonely and struggling?”
“If it’s my body you want, then go ahead. Do as you please.”
Although their relationship begins without affection, Katia somehow finds herself paying more attention to Leonid than to the Crown Prince…

117267.synopsis:
Ten years after death, Wade was resurrected as a skeleton in a desolate wasteland. He thought he’d vanish like fading embers, but unexpectedly, a mysterious twenty-sided die led him into one legendary tale after another.
This is simply the story of a dead man who never stops moving forward.
— Swords and sorcery, homesteading, adventure.

118803.synopsis:
To everyone else, Lu Zhou is the cold, untouchable school heartthrob — proud, elite, and unreachable, a star shining high above.
But Shen Yihuan knows the truth:
His love is intense — so intense it makes you want to run.
To Lu Zhou, Shen Yihuan wasn’t just someone special in a sea of people.
She was an accident sent by the world —
a downpour,
a blaze,
a force that turned his world upside down.
—
In the military, everyone knows that Captain Lu has an unusually bold tattoo on his back —
A cherry blossom vine, vivid and striking like a painting, inked with the richest hues.
One day, a female doctor on aid duty shyly asks him:
“Is that tattoo in memory of someone special?”
Lu Zhou replies flatly, extinguishing his cigarette:
“No.”
But his diary says otherwise:
My love is heavy, selfish, dark, and hopeless — and yet, I love you.
I want to lock you away in a place without light.
I want to dig out every part of your heart that ever belonged to anyone else.
I want to entangle, devour, and possess you again and again — hear your sobs, see your fear, your surrender.
— Lu Zhou’s Diary 2
When Shen Yihuan grew up, she never forgot their military training at 16 — the scorching sun, the ice-cold watermelon, and that pure-looking boy.
Everyone said Lu Zhou was aloof, distant, self-restrained — no one had ever seen him smile at a girl.
Later, people heard that the famously popular Shen Yihuan was chasing him —
But Lu Zhou always seemed indifferent.
Only Shen Yihuan knew what really happened.
That night, during self-study, when the school lost power and everyone cheered to go home —
She was dragged into a dark hallway.
Lu Zhou cornered her, breath ragged, unable to restrain himself — and kissed her.

126483.synopsis:
The pure and immaculate iris flower, filled with a sense of justice—Bai Yao chose to bear all responsibility for the sake of kindness in her heart.
After receiving triple the retirement pay, she thought she could finally enjoy a peaceful life, spending ordinary days with her playful younger sister.
But the arrival of the greedy witch shattered that peace, and the former magical girl, Iris Flower, turned into the terrifying and arrogant witch…
associated_names: 堕入魔女的我喜欢捉弄魔法少女

134163.synopsis:
Lu Qi found himself in an escape game teeming with monsters and bizarre players.
The monsters were terrifying, but even more horrifying was the game’s tendency to assign players absurd character settings at random.
Congratulations, player, you’ve drawn the “Saint” persona.
[1. You are a saint.] 
[2. As a saint, you must perform good deeds to raise your Saint Index to 100%.] 
[3. Any aggressive actions are forbidden until your Saint Index reaches 100%.] 
The cold and ruthless expert Lu Qi stared at this wildly mismatched character setting, his lips twitching in disbelief.
[Saint Index has reached 100%. Dark Transformation command now permitted.] 
In an instant, Lu Qi grabbed a kitchen knife and chased the monsters into a frenzied scramble.
Under the system’s guidance, Lu Qi dragged a wounded, peerlessly beautiful man back from the streets.
The man was stunning, an excellent cook, and gentle in demeanor—except for the fact that he had grown a few things he shouldn’t have.
Initially planning to carry this clueless newbie along purely for the eye candy, Lu Qi was stunned when Ji Qinglin brandished a long blade and effortlessly sliced through the monsters.
Lu Qi: I’m the clueless one.
This wasn’t the beginning of the game—it was the ending.
The entire universe had gathered a faint glimmer of light, intending to alter this outcome, and then entrusted that light to an emotionally unstable madman.
The final boss had long since appeared. Players must be extremely cautious to avoid being bewitched.
Ji Qinglin (blinking his large, innocent eyes): Do you really want me to disappear?
Prologue: Save the puppy.
Finale: Kill the god.
Cross-dressing, pure-hearted gong × Refined, split-personality shou
Ji Qinglin: My dream is to become someone’s puppy—to be doted on, needed, have my fur stroked, and willingly stay by their side forever.
Lu Qi: If you’re a dog, you’re Cerberus, the hellhound that spews venom. Who would dare keep you?
(Actually: Venomous beauty gong × Mad rabbit shou)

138259.synopsis:
In 1999, after graduating from the police academy, Li Shumei entered the Criminal Investigation Brigade of the Qindong City Bureau and became a young policewoman.
Criminal investigation and solving cases were especially demanding. The first time she went to a crime scene, Li Shumei gathered up all kinds of “problems”. She vomited when she saw the corpse, fell while chasing the suspect, and even fainted when she heard gunfire. She truly fainted.
The veteran detectives, anxious to solve the case, directly rushed to the bureau chief’s office, hoping the bureau could replace her with someone else.
 Fortunately, under the bureau director’s reassurance, Li Shumei stayed.
In that era, there were few methods for solving cases, and technology was lacking, so many cases remained unresolved.
What the veteran detectives did not expect was that three days later, relying on a portrait drawn by Li Shumei, they successfully found the vicious and elusive mu*derer.
Within just a few months, Li Shumei even helped the bureau successfully solve several major cases, and she was called an expert in criminal investigation sketching.
At the celebration party, a colleague asked her: “Shumei, when did you learn to draw? It looks so much like the real person, it’s amazingly similar!”
Li Shumei said: “I just added some of my own deductions when sketching, such as criminal psychological profiling…”
In fact, Li Shumei never thought that she possessed a super ability in criminal investigation sketching.
Relying on a witness’s few words, a vague figure, a victim’s skull, or even the victim’s diary—
She could imagine the appearance of the mu*derer or the victim, and the similarity rate reached as high as 99%!
associated_names: 我靠画像破案成了警界瑰宝[刑侦]

138771.synopsis: I was summoned to another world by being caught up with a bunch of idiots, but despite having the lowest ability, I received three blessings due to a slip-up by the Tamer God. Relying solely on those blessings, I’m honing my tamer skills and living freely by utilizing my summoned beasts. I dream of the day I can return to Japan…
associated_names: テイマーの能力は最低だが、召喚した創造神とテイマー神の加護二つ ？

161555.synopsis:
An online game created by unidentified beings.
A virtual reality illusion that swept the world into a frenzy in an instant.
Geon-yeong, who encounters this mysterious virtual reality, chooses every class with his trademark confidence.
Park Geon’s classic fusion fantasy returns once again!

194067.synopsis:
Nan Liujing woke up to find himself kidnapped by an evil game system called Island Survival. From then on, he said goodbye to Planet Earth; the rest of his life was now tied to a barren, desolate little island.
What do they mean by “starting with one island, all resources depend on the grind”?
Facing a deserted island where even birds wouldn’t poop, Nan Liujing developed a hoarding habit.
No way. He had to start grinding!!!
He went beachcombing, farmed, raised slimes, and whenever he had free time, he set sail to explore resource islands and trade with the natives.
Gradually, the tiny island expanded again and again, and the wasteland turned into fertile fields. Ranches were opened, windmills were built, and Nan Liujing could not only be self-sufficient but also regularly set up stalls on the natives’ islands to sell agricultural products. The money he earned was immediately turned around to buy more practical alchemy tools.
Automatic sprinklers? Good stuff, bought!
After the 30-day novice period passed, the game revealed its sinister true face. Natural disasters struck one after another: extreme cold, high temperatures, rainstorms, eternal night… every 30 days brought a severe test to the players.
Nan Liujing was always among the best-prepared group.
When the blizzard arrived, Nan Liujing sat in his warm farmhouse, toasting by the cozy fireplace, sipping hot cocoa while stroking the cat curled up into a ball on his lap.
Ah, bliss.
It wasn’t that the game lacked combat elements, but “Life-type” players didn’t care for all that killing and fighting.
Of course, if some blind fool dared to disturb his farming, Nan Liujing would unhesitatingly… plant them into the soil.
Important Note: The setting of this article is inspired by several Harvest Moon games. Any similarities are definitely my tribute!
associated_names: 海岛求生：生活玩家种田囤货
